title: Categorical kernel comparison for the dual of a finite free constant matrix
statement: Let X, Λ, n, m and g be as in lem-weil-pbc-constant-finite-matrix-dual-kernel. The categorical kernel of the internal-Hom dual of the constant sheaf map induced by g is isomorphic to the constant sheaf on the categorical ModuleCat kernel of ModuleCat.ofHom g.dualMap.

source.place: IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.ihom_unit docstring; finite free kernel step

proof.text: Identify finite free modules with finite biproducts of the coefficient module, transport the dual map through the monoidal constant sheaf functor, and use preservation of finite kernels.

proof_origin.place: finite free transpose and constant kernel argument

lean.statement:
theorem constantFiniteMatrixDualKernelIso_aux
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ]
    (n m : ℕ) (g : (Fin m → Λ) →ₗ[Λ] (Fin n → Λ)) :
    Nonempty (kernel
      ((MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj
        (𝟙_ (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))).map
          ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).map
            (ModuleCat.ofHom g)).op) ≅
      (constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
        (kernel (ModuleCat.ofHom g.dualMap)))
